summary: Ameresco filed an 8-K reporting the closing of a joint venture contribution and equity purchase agreement. Through its subsidiary, it contributed its biogas business to Neogenyx Fuels LLC in exchange for a 70% equity interest. HASI affiliate invested $400 million, receiving a 30% interest; $100 million cash was paid to Ameresco at close, ~$58 million used to reduce a loan, and the remainder contributed to the JV. No board recommendation or advisor named. Structurally, this is a spin-off-like transfer of assets into a separate entity with external capital. Watch for operational integration, JV governance, and potential monetization of the retained stake.
